## Textbook practice {#practice}

CambridgeMATHS NSW Year 10, Stage 5 Core & Advanced/Extension Paths, third edition (2024).

| Time | Core practice |
|:--|:--|
| 10 min | **Exercise 1B, p. 13: Q2(c, d, e, f).** Solve and check each answer by substitution. |
| 21 min | **Exercise 1B, p. 13: Q2(g, i, j, k, l, m, n, o).** Show each step and check in the original equation. |
| 4 min | **Exercise 1B, p. 15: Q13(a, b).** Solve both ways, choose a method and explain your preference. |
| 5 min | Check against the **answers on p. 858**. Find the first incorrect line and redo any part you missed. |

**If you get stuck:** revisit “Subtracting a bracket” for sign errors, “Two valid ways to start” for method choice, or “Check in the original equation” for substitution.
